TAKEAWAY

The gospel transforms people to live wholly for Christ.

⸻

DIVISION 1 — GOSPEL CLAIM

Romans 1:1–7

Principle

Through the gospel, Christ claims us to belong wholly to Him.

Application Question

What area of your life is hardest to live as though it truly belongs to Christ? Why?

[30-SECOND COUNTDOWN]

⸻

DIVISION 2 — GOSPEL PASSION

Romans 1:8–15

Principle

The gospel gives us a passion to see others come to Christ and grow in Him.

Application Question

Who do you want to see come to Christ or grow in Him—and what holds you back?

[30-SECOND COUNTDOWN]

⸻

DIVISION 3 — GOSPEL POWER

Romans 1:16–17

Principle

The gospel gives us a righteous standing from which we can live by faith.

No application question / countdown after Division 3.
